preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
There must be exactly n - 1 roads connecting the cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{d_i} ' + ' '.join(map(str, roads_i)) for d_i, roads_i in days)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of days k followed by the roads repaired each day.

postconditions.expression: all(len(roads_i) == d_i for d_i, roads_i in days)
postconditions.description: Each day's output must correctly reflect the number of roads repaired that day.

postconditions.expression: all(any(road in roads_i for roads_i in days) for road in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: All roads must be included in the output across the k days.
